{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "furszy",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "initially Concept ACKed, then objected that low-level aborts prevent clean shutdown/flushing"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "concerned about diagnostics and advocates catching exceptions at thread boundaries for graceful shutdown"
    },
    {
      "login": "josibake",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objects to low-level primitives making policy decisions instead of propagating exceptions"
    },
    {
      "login": "l0rinc",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK with no rationale"
    },
    {
      "login": "optout21",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "leans NACK against low-level context-free aborts over context-aware error handling"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:4905070230",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "clobbers specific filesystem error categories into a generic failure without logging diagnostic details",
      "quote": "This now clobbers a potential existence, or permissions error into a disk space fault. The goal in my mind should be to make diagnostics easier. If we really want to clobber all error categories and report which function failed, rather than why something went wrong, shouldn't we at least be logging some detail?",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4905670483",
        "c:4925576401"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:4970120577",
      "settled_by_quote": "The extra logging of the error code and the new tests are good"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4925846440",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "making process termination policy decisions in low-level primitives prevents callers from handling or propagating errors cleanly",
      "quote": "With your most recent push, I still think this PR is repeating the same bad pattern of having a policy decision being made in a low level primitive. The function should do what its asked (check the disk space) and give an exception back to the caller if it cannot complete the task. The caller then decides to either do something with the exception, or just let it propagate up",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4970381638"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3559484504",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "unclean aborts in low-level file operations prevent other critical subsystems like the wallet or chainstate from cleanly flushing to disk",
      "quote": "I don't think a low-level unclean shutdown is the right approach. An error accessing an index directory or another unrelated file shouldn't prevent the chain or wallet from attempting to flush their state to disk. They could be living in a different storage location.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3559598062",
        "rc:3559984035",
        "rc:3588398949"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4945070230",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "aborting inside utility functions bypasses top-level thread exception handling that could trigger an orderly shutdown",
      "quote": "In my opinion this is most clearly solved by throwing exceptions and catching them as close to the module/thread boundaries as possible.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4970381638",
        "c:4971257134"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4970120577",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "low-level context-free aborts prevent clean shutdown and context-aware error handling",
      "quote": "I have a weak inclination towards N.A.C.K-ing the approach, on the grounds that higher-level context-aware error handling is preferable against low-level context-free abort.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4970381638"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4904633140",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "related to https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35003#discussion_r3424554696",
      "substantive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4909442592",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial iteration was Concept ACKed, but multiple reviewers (furszy, josibake, sedited, optout21) have raised blocking architectural and safety objections against calling abort in low-level utilities instead of allowing exceptions to propagate to thread boundaries for graceful shutdown."
}
